title: Define the cooperation and terminal UI contract
goal: Define how contributions, commitments, addressed communication, and user decisions pass through observable terminal controls and the trusted kernel.
scope: Specify contribution selection, Arbiter decisions, commitment lifecycles, and conflict exclusion.
Define scenarios in which proposals change admitted work while authority remains in the kernel.
Define terminal interaction and public MCP over stdio over the same trusted application commands.
acceptance: The reviewed contract includes scenarios for useful overlap and conflicting-work exclusion with recorded assignments and outcomes.
Commitments have explicit acceptance, completion, expiry, and release behavior.
The terminal UI contract exposes session progress, decisions requiring the user, cancellation, and truthful limitations.
The public MCP contract reuses the trusted application boundary and does not create a second authority path.
context: This task is intentionally unscheduled until checked result delivery is implemented and accepted.
